messages:
ana: Heads-up — onboarding kirin-v2-q5 to staging. Quick smoke flagged a pack of locale regressions: Korean honorific suffixes dropped (outputs become informal), Chinese spelled numerals emitted as ASCII digits, and Arabic punctuation spacing (commas detach / appear on LTR side). Anyone seen this combo? @cheng @tom :eyes:

cheng: Can you paste a minimal repro and which tokenizer shipped in the model bundle?

ana: Minimal curl repro (single line):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY" -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"kirin-v2-q5","input":"\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4.","max_tokens":48,"temperature":0}'
```
Observed (staging kirin-v2-q5):
- KO: polite suffix removed -> output informal (lost \u2018-시-\u2019 honorific)
- CN: input "\u7b2c\u4e00\u7b2c\u4e8c\u7b2c\u4e09" -> output "1 2 3" (digits)
- AR: input punctuation ends up with space before comma and comma renders on LTR side

eval-bot: Auto-eval snapshot:
- ko-honorific BLEU delta: -3.0
- cn-numeral CER delta: +2.2
- ar-rtl-punct F1 delta: -14%

tom: Primary suspects: (1) tokenizer mismatch (bundle vs runtime) -> different subtokens; (2) quantization fused low-frequency suffix vectors; (3) detokenizer/normalizer regression for Arabic punctuation. Two quick diagnostics: tokenization diff + run with `?trace=true` to capture token traces/logits.

maria: FYI the model bundle lists tokenizer_v5.1.json in the tar, but staging runtime defaulted to tokenizer_v5.0 unless manifest pinned. That smells like the subtoken problem.

cheng: Run a tokenization diff like this:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
new = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v5.1.json')
old = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v5.0.json')
text = '\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4.'
print('v5.1 ->', new.encode(text).tokens)
print('v5.0 ->', old.encode(text).tokens)
```
If the suffix tokenization differs we should pin the tokenizer in the manifest and rerun smoke.

ana: Ran diff locally: v5.1 tokenizes the honorific as two pieces ([stem, _suffix]) while v5.0 had a single merged token. I pinned tokenizer_v5.1 in the manifest and re-ran the smoke. KO and CN numeral issues are fixed on staging. Arabic punctuation still broken.

tom: Add `?trace=true` to the generate call and dump the token trace + logits around the punctuation tokens so we can see whether the model already prefers the space+comma sequence or if detok moves punctuation after decode.

ana: Posted a short trace excerpt (sanitized):
```
token_seq: [..., 0x0627, 0x0644, 0x0633, 0x0627, 0x0644, 0x0020, 0x002c, 0x061f]
logits (excerpt) around space+comma: [ -2.1, +1.8, +3.6 ]  # indicates the model prefers <space> + "," token
```
Interpretation: model logits already favor the extra-space+comma sequence (float checkpoint shows same). That points to preprocessing/training-data signal rather than a detok-only bug or quant artifact.

maria: Good narrowing. Immediate actions: 1) add manifest assert that tokenizer.json SHA + vocab.tsv are present in model bundle (will open PR); 2) bisect preprocessing/corpus-normalization commits that touched Arabic punctuation and find when the `space+punct` pattern appeared; 3) short-term: add a post-decode detok heuristic that collapses space before punctuation for Arabic ranges as a stop-gap; 4) run a float vs q5 parity to be sure quant didn't amplify the bias (you already ran float, it matches).

cheng: I'll add a tiny onboarding smoke test (KR honorific + CN numerals) so future onboarding fails fast if tokenizer not pinned.

eval-bot: Filed ticket INF-7122: pin tokenizer on onboarding, add onboarding assert + smoke, bisect preprocessing for Arabic space-before-punct, add stop-gap detok rule, monitor nightly regressions.

ana: I'll kick off the preprocessing bisect and paste results into INF-7122. Thanks all :thumbsup:
